This '''species''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[near-Human]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] possessing [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and ridged craniums. Male members of this species were [[Hair/Legends|hairless]], with wrinkled skin, while females possessed light blue hair and much smoother features. [[Cabrool Nuum|Cabrool]], [[Norba Nuum|Norba]], and [[Rusk Nuum]] were all members of this species.<ref name="JTH TDT" />
